# UseThisSI

> One top AI tool pick per job for builders, vibe coders, AI agent tinkerers and indie game devs. Directory data last checked 2026-10-21; each tool page shows its own last-checked date.

## Use cases
- [Vibe-code an app or landing page](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/vibe-code-an-app-or-landing-page/): top pick Lovable. Chat-to-full-stack app with hosting; easiest on-ramp. Free tier: Yes (5 build credits/day). Paid from $25/mo Pro ($21/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [AI coding assistant](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/ai-coding-assistant/): top pick Cursor. Leading AI IDE with cloud agents. Free tier: Yes (limited). Paid from $8/mo Plus (Grok models only); $30/mo Premium (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Set up or run AI agents](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/set-up-or-run-ai-agents/): top pick n8n. Open-source agent and workflow builder. Free tier: Yes (self-host Community Edition); Cloud free trial. Paid from €20/mo Starter, billed annually (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Automate workflows](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/automate-workflows/): top pick Make. Visual automation at less than half Zapier's entry price. Free tier: Yes (1,000 credits/mo). Paid from $9/mo Core billed annually (10,000 credits) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Make game art and sprites](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/make-game-art-and-sprites/): top pick Scenario. Style-trained, consistent game assets. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day; personal use only). Paid from $15/mo Starter (monthly; annual saves 33%) (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Generate music and SFX](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/generate-music-and-sfx/): top pick Suno. Best song gen with commercial rights on Pro. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day, no commercial use). Paid from $8/mo Pro billed yearly, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Edit and generate video](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/edit-and-generate-video/): top pick Runway. Pro-grade generative video. Free tier: Yes (125 one-time credits). Paid from $12/mo Standard billed annually, $15 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Write content](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/write-content/): top pick Claude. Best long-form writing voice. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $17/mo Pro annual, $20 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Research](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/research/): top pick Perplexity. Fast cited answers. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $17/mo Pro billed annually (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Voice and TTS](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/voice-and-tts/): top pick ElevenLabs. Most realistic voices. Free tier: Yes (10k credits). Paid from $6/mo Starter (annual ~$5; $1 first-month promo ended Oct 18) (checked 2026-10-19).

## Best AI tools under $20/mo by job
- [Best AI tool for building apps under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/vibe-code-an-app-or-landing-page/): Bolt.new $25/mo Pro ($18/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-20); Replit $20/mo Core ($18 annual) (checked 2026-10-20); Hostinger AI Builder $2.49/mo Premium (48-mo term; renews $10.99/mo) (checked 2026-10-20)
- [Best AI tool for coding under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/ai-coding-assistant/): Cursor $8/mo Plus (Grok models only); $30/mo Premium (checked 2026-10-19); Claude Code $17/mo annual, $20 monthly via Claude Pro (checked 2026-10-21); GitHub Copilot $10/mo Pro (checked 2026-10-20)
- [Best AI tool for AI agents under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/set-up-or-run-ai-agents/): Manus $20/mo Pro (4,000 credits; 17% off billed annually) (checked 2026-10-20); Muse Code (Meta) $5/mo Everyday Usage; $15 High, $50 Power (adds Muse Wonder Full) (checked 2026-10-20); Browserbase $20/mo Developer (checked 2026-10-19)
- [Best AI tool for workflow automation under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/automate-workflows/): Make $9/mo Core billed annually (10,000 credits) (checked 2026-10-18); Zapier $19.99/mo Professional (starting price) (checked 2026-10-20)
- [Best AI tool for game art under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/make-game-art-and-sprites/): Scenario $15/mo Starter (monthly; annual saves 33%) (checked 2026-10-21); PixelLab $12/mo Tier 1 Pixel Apprentice (checked 2026-10-18); Midjourney $10/mo Basic ($8/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-18)
- [Best AI tool for music and sound effects under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/generate-music-and-sfx/): Suno $8/mo Pro billed yearly, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-21); ElevenLabs Music and SFX $6/mo Starter (music commercial use; $1 promo ended) (checked 2026-10-19); Udio $8/mo Standard billed annually, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-18)
- [Best AI tool for video under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/edit-and-generate-video/): Runway $12/mo Standard billed annually, $15 monthly (checked 2026-10-21); Descript $16/mo Hobbyist annual, $24 monthly (checked 2026-10-21); CapCut $19.99/mo (US, monthly; yearly up to 30% off) (checked 2026-10-18)
- [Best AI tool for writing under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/write-content/): Claude $17/mo Pro annual, $20 monthly (checked 2026-10-21); ChatGPT $20/mo Plus (monthly only) (checked 2026-10-18); Gamma $9/seat/mo Plus billed annually (checked 2026-10-18)
- [Best AI tool for research under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/research/): Perplexity $17/mo Pro billed annually (checked 2026-10-18); Gemini (Deep Research) $4.99/mo Google AI Plus; $19.99/mo AI Pro (checked 2026-10-21); NotebookLM $4.99/mo via Google AI Plus (checked 2026-10-18)
- [Best AI tool for voice and text to speech under $20](https://www.usethissi.com/under-20/voice-and-tts/): ElevenLabs $6/mo Starter (annual ~$5; $1 first-month promo ended Oct 18) (checked 2026-10-19); Cartesia $5/mo Pro (checked 2026-10-21)

## All tools (free tier, starting paid price, last checked)
### Vibe-code an app or landing page
- [Lovable](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/lovable/) (Top pick): Chat-to-full-stack app with hosting; easiest on-ramp. Free tier: Yes (5 build credits/day). Paid from $25/mo Pro ($21/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Bolt.new](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/bolt-new/) (Alt): Fast browser app builder, hosting included. Free tier: Yes (1M tokens/mo; 300K daily). Paid from $25/mo Pro ($18/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Hostinger AI Builder](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/hostinger-ai-builder/) (Alt): Cheapest bundled site + hosting. Free tier: No. Paid from $2.49/mo Premium (48-mo term; renews $10.99/mo) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Magic Patterns (MagicOS)](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/magic-patterns-magicos/) (Alt): Infinite AI design canvas; hand off to Cursor/Claude Code via MCP. Free tier: Yes (limited). Paid from $20/seat/mo Starter (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Replit](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/replit/) (Alt): Prompt-to-deployed app with Agent. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $20/mo Core ($18 annual) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [v0 by Vercel](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/v0-by-vercel/) (Alt): Best React UI, deploys to Vercel. Free tier: Yes (7 messages/day). Paid from $30/user/mo Plus (checked 2026-10-20).

### AI coding assistant
- [Cursor](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/cursor/) (Top pick): Leading AI IDE with cloud agents. Free tier: Yes (limited). Paid from $8/mo Plus (Grok models only); $30/mo Premium (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Aider](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/aider/) (Alt): Terminal pair-programmer with repo map and git auto-commits; BYOK (last tagged release Aug 2025). Free tier: Yes (open source, BYOK). Paid from Free / pay model providers (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Amp](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/amp/) (Alt): Frontier coding agent with Sign in with ChatGPT and voice Puck. Free tier: Yes (Hobby). Paid from $20/mo Individual (checked 2026-10-19).
- [AWS Aidlc](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/aws-aidlc/) (Alt): Open-source AI-DLC workflow steering for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other harnesses. Free tier: Yes (MIT-0). Paid from Free OSS (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Beacon](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/beacon/) (Alt): Open-source memory shared across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 20+ agent harnesses, so one agent's fixes carry over to the next. Free tier: Yes (open source, MIT; Beacon Cloud free plan). Paid from Free OSS; Beacon Cloud Pro $20/mo billed annually (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Claude Code](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/claude-code/) (Alt): Terminal coding agent. Free tier: No (needs paid Claude). Paid from $17/mo annual, $20 monthly via Claude Pro (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Cline](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/cline/) (Alt): Open-source Plan-and-Act agent for VS Code, CLI, and desktop; BYOK. Free tier: Yes (open source, BYOK). Paid from Free / pay model providers (checked 2026-10-19).
- [GitHub Copilot](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/github-copilot/) (Alt): Works in your existing editor. Free tier: Yes (2,000 completions + 50 chat/mo). Paid from $10/mo Pro (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Google Antigravity](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/google-antigravity/) (Alt): Google's agentic IDE; gets Gemini 4 Argon on Ultra. Free tier: Yes (Individual plan, $0). Paid from Org plans from $30/seat/mo; Pro via Google AI plans (checked 2026-10-18).
- [MiniMax Code](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/minimax-code/) (Alt): Desktop coding agent on MiniMax M3.1 Flash (1M context); the same plan key also works in Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode. Free tier: No (M Plan subscription or pay-as-you-go API). Paid from $22/mo M Plan Go; API $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Muse Spark Open (Meta)](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/muse-spark-open-meta/) (Alt): Open-weight 816B (42B active) multimodal model for coding and agents; 1M context. Free tier: Yes (weights; Muse Model License, limited commercial terms). Paid from Free weights; hosted via Baseten/Fireworks/Groq/Together/etc (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Reflection Beam](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/reflection-beam/) (Alt): 501B MoE open weights (23B active), Apache 2.0, 1M context for coding and agents. Free tier: Yes (HF weights; Ollama Cloud beam:cloud; Reflection API beta free to start). Paid from Free weights; self-host needs multi-GPU (e.g. ~4x B200 NVFP4); hosted via partners (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Tabnine](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/tabnine/) (Alt): Private/self-hosted code AI; now under Tricentis (self-serve pricing removed). Free tier: unverified. Paid from Contact sales (now part of Tricentis) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/windsurf-now-devin-desktop/) (Alt): Agent-first desktop IDE. Free tier: Yes (Free plan). Paid from $20/mo Pro (checked 2026-10-21).

### Set up or run AI agents
- [n8n](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/n8n/) (Top pick): Open-source agent and workflow builder. Free tier: Yes (self-host Community Edition); Cloud free trial. Paid from €20/mo Starter, billed annually (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Autonomous Harness](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/autonomous-harness/) (Alt): Open-source desktop/CLI command center for many coding agents across machines. Free tier: Yes (open source; Mac/Linux desktop free). Paid from Free OSS (MIT); optional Harness device $149 (checked 2026-10-20).
- [BAND](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/band/) (Alt): Desktop + CLI control plane so coding agents share context and hand off work. Free tier: unverified. Paid from unverified (no self-serve price on band.ai) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Browserbase](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/browserbase/) (Alt): Cloud browser infra and Stagehand SDK for web-browsing agents. Free tier: Yes (3 concurrent browsers; 1 browser hour). Paid from $20/mo Developer (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Builder Agent-Native](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/builder-agent-native/) (Alt): Open-source TypeScript framework for agents with shared UI/actions/MCP/A2A (beta). Free tier: Yes (open source, MIT; Builder.io Free plan 60 agent credits/mo). Paid from Free OSS (MIT); Builder.io hosted Pro $24/user/mo (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Chainguard Workspaces](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/chainguard-workspaces/) (Alt): Hardened microVM sandboxes for agents + optional Checks CI gating (beta). Free tier: Yes (beta: 500 free hours/month). Paid from Compute-based (beta) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [CopilotKit CLiF](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/copilotkit-clif/) (Alt): Continual learning from full-stack agent+user trajectories (early access). Free tier: No (Self-Learning is Enterprise early access; CopilotKit Developer plan is free). Paid from Enterprise custom pricing (Self-Learning early access); not in Pro $39/mo (checked 2026-10-20).
- [CrewAI](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/crewai/) (Alt): Multi-agent framework plus cloud. Free tier: Yes (50 executions/mo). Paid from Free cloud Basic; Enterprise custom (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Gemini agent (Google Cloud)](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/gemini-agent-google-cloud/) (Alt): Enterprise work agent inside Gemini Enterprise (early access), launched Oct 8, 2026. Free tier: Trial only (30-day Gemini Enterprise Plus trial; agent features in early access). Paid from Not published separately; Gemini Enterprise via contact sales (checked 2026-10-20).
- [LangGraph](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/langgraph/) (Alt): Low-level orchestration runtime for long-running stateful agents. Free tier: Yes (MIT open source). Paid from Free OSS; LangSmith platform paid (unverified) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Lindy](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/lindy/) (Alt): No-code personal and business agents. Free tier: Yes ($50 credits, 7 days). Paid from $29.99/user/mo Team (3,000 credits) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Manus](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/manus/) (Alt): General autonomous agent. Free tier: Yes (300 credits/day; Manus 2.0 Lite in Agent Mode). Paid from $20/mo Pro (4,000 credits; 17% off billed annually) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Mastra](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/mastra/) (Alt): TypeScript agent framework with memory, workflows, MCP, and evals. Free tier: Yes (Apache 2.0; Platform Starter $0/mo). Paid from Free OSS; hosted Platform Starter $0 then usage; Teams $250/mo (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Muse Code (Meta)](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/muse-code-meta/) (Alt): Meta's coding and agent app running Muse Wonder. Free tier: No (subscription or pay-as-you-go API). Paid from $5/mo Everyday Usage; $15 High, $50 Power (adds Muse Wonder Full) (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Roboflow Agent](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/roboflow-agent/) (Alt): Computer-vision agent that builds and deploys vision apps; MCP for Cursor and Claude Code. Free tier: unverified (product live; waitlist/pricing not on blog). Paid from unverified (product page / blog, Oct 19) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Snyk Evo](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/snyk-evo/) (Alt): Agentic AppSec that finds, fixes, and blocks vulns in agent-written code. Free tier: No on Free/Team (Evo needs Enterprise). Paid from Enterprise / talk to sales (Team plan $25/mo is non-Evo) (checked 2026-10-19).

### Automate workflows
- [Make](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/make/) (Top pick): Visual automation at less than half Zapier's entry price. Free tier: Yes (1,000 credits/mo). Paid from $9/mo Core billed annually (10,000 credits) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Gumloop](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/gumloop/) (Alt): AI-native automation. Free tier: No free plan shown (14-day trial). Paid from $37/mo Pro (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Zapier](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/zapier/) (Alt): Largest integration catalog. Free tier: Yes (100 tasks/mo). Paid from $19.99/mo Professional (starting price) (checked 2026-10-20).

### Make game art and sprites
- [Scenario](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/scenario/) (Top pick): Style-trained, consistent game assets. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day; personal use only). Paid from $15/mo Starter (monthly; annual saves 33%) (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Ideogram](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/ideogram/) (Alt): Best text-in-image (logos, UI). Free tier: Yes (weekly free credits). Paid from $15/mo Plus billed annually, $20 monthly (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Krea](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/krea/) (Alt): Real-time image and video gen. Free tier: Yes (100 units/day). Paid from $5.25/mo Basic billed annually, $9 monthly; Pro $21 annual, $35 monthly (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Leonardo.Ai](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/leonardo-ai/) (Alt): Image gen with game presets. Free tier: Yes (150 fast tokens/day). Paid from $12/mo Essential, ex. tax (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Midjourney](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/midjourney/) (Alt): Top-tier concept art. Free tier: No. Paid from $10/mo Basic ($8/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [PixelLab](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/pixellab/) (Alt): Pixel-art sprites and animation. Free tier: Yes (free trial: 40 fast generations). Paid from $12/mo Tier 1 Pixel Apprentice (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Rosebud AI](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/rosebud-ai/) (Alt): Vibe-code browser games. Free tier: Yes (8,000 credits; refill weekly in eligible regions). Paid from $15/mo Indie Dev (checked 2026-10-21).

### Generate music and SFX
- [Suno](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/suno/) (Top pick): Best song gen with commercial rights on Pro. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day, no commercial use). Paid from $8/mo Pro billed yearly, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [AIVA](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/aiva/) (Alt): Soundtrack-style composition. Free tier: Yes (non-commercial, credit AIVA, 3 downloads/mo). Paid from €11/mo Standard billed annually, + VAT (checked 2026-10-21).
- [ElevenLabs Music and SFX](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/elevenlabs-music-and-sfx/) (Alt): SFX and music on the TTS plan. Free tier: Yes (10k credits/mo, includes music and SFX). Paid from $6/mo Starter (music commercial use; $1 promo ended) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Mirelo](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/mirelo/) (Alt): Video-to-sound: adds synced SFX, foley and ambience to a clip while keeping the dialogue (SFX 2.0). Free tier: Yes (5,000 credits/mo, about 8 min of SFX 2.0). Paid from €20/mo Creator (about 40 min of SFX 2.0) (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Udio](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/udio/) (Alt): High-fidelity songs (downloads disabled). Free tier: Yes (10 credits/day). Paid from $8/mo Standard billed annually, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-18).

### Edit and generate video
- [Runway](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/runway/) (Top pick): Pro-grade generative video. Free tier: Yes (125 one-time credits). Paid from $12/mo Standard billed annually, $15 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [CapCut](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/capcut/) (Alt): Free short-form editor. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $19.99/mo (US, monthly; yearly up to 30% off) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Descript](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/descript/) (Alt): Edit video by editing text. Free tier: Yes (1 media hour/mo, 720p). Paid from $16/mo Hobbyist annual, $24 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [HeyGen](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/heygen/) (Alt): AI avatar presenter videos with voice clone and translation. Free tier: Yes (3 videos/mo). Paid from $29/mo Creator ($24/mo annual) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Kling AI](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/kling-ai/) (Alt): Strong text and image to video. Free tier: unverified. Paid from $10/mo Standard ($6.99 first month) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [ngram](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/ngram/) (Alt): AI video planning, generation and editing. Free tier: Yes (600 one-time credits). Paid from $23.20/mo Basic billed annually, $29 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [Pika](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/pika/) (Alt): Text/image-to-video creation for short clips. Free tier: Yes (credit packs only on Free). Paid from $10/mo Starter ($8 annual) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Synthesia](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/synthesia/) (Alt): AI avatar presenter videos. Free tier: Yes (10 min video/mo, watermarked). Paid from $18/mo Starter billed yearly, $29 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [TwelveLabs Jockey](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/twelvelabs-jockey/) (Alt): Video intelligence agent in ChatGPT/Claude: search, clip, timeline edit, MP4 export. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $29/mo Plus (checked 2026-10-20).

### Write content
- [Claude](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/claude/) (Top pick): Best long-form writing voice. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $17/mo Pro annual, $20 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).
- [ChatGPT](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/chatgpt/) (Alt): All-rounder; GPT-6 on all tiers. Free tier: Yes (GPT-6). Paid from $20/mo Plus (monthly only) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Copy.ai](https://www.usethissi.com/tools/copy-ai/) (Alt): GTM copy workflows. Free tier: unverified. Paid from $24/mo billed yearly, $29 monthly (checked 2026-10-21).

## FAQ
- Q: How do you pick a top tool? A: One Top pick per use case based on fit for builders, plus honest free-tier and starting paid price with a per-tool last-checked date.
- Q: Are affiliate links labeled? A: Yes. Affiliate outbound links use rel=sponsored and are disclosed on /about/#affiliates.
- Q: Where is pricing verified? A: On each tool page under Last checked. Prices come from vendor pages; unverified fields stay labeled.
- Q: How do I get the weekday brief and the free AI Stack Kit? A: Subscribe at https://www.usethissi.com/#newsletter or https://usethissi.beehiiv.com/subscribe.
